emails.name: Shampa Raghunathan
emails.subject: Internship Inquiry: GNN for Molecular Property Prediction
emails.body:
Dear Professor Raghunathan,

I am a third-year CS undergraduate who built a graph neural network-based molecule property predictor using PyTorch Geometric, achieving 0.91 ROC-AUC on the Tox21 dataset.

I read your recent paper "Graph Neural Network for 3‐Dimensional Structures Including Dihedral Angles for Molecular Property Prediction" in the Journal of Computational Chemistry. Your approach to incorporating 3D structural information into GNNs for molecular property prediction aligns with my interest in molecular graph learning.

I am seeking a two-month summer research internship in your group to gain experience in machine learning applications in materials science and molecular interactions. Would you be open to discussing potential opportunities for this internship?

Best regards,
Test Student

I am seeking a two-month summer research internship in your group to gain experience in molecular graph-based machine learning and computational drug discovery methods. Would you be open to discussing potential opportunities for such an internship?
